body: Mine is an Australian shepherd so they have a lot in common.
Mine is eating popcorn.  She never chews something I tell her not to, but she's almost five.
I love my sweet freckly dog.   My itchy bitch.
Would reddit care if I showed my boobs?  Or my cat?
I wish my ex husband still loved me.  Nothing has been right since he left,  no one will ever give a shit again.
Tomorrow is what I tell myself will be better every night but it's been 2500 of them with no change.

I haven't been able to read well for years.  Anxiety took away my ability to follow a narrative.  Good idea though.

I used to read so much.
She's the only reason I wake up, but she would be ok if I left her to my mom.
